generated.details: On the middle-plane right tabletop, the label-free document storage box has rigid gray fiberboard walls and a fitted lift-off lid.
Immediately to its right, the small abstract metal sculpture consists of a bent brushed-steel ribbon secured to a flat weighted base.
At far left beside the table, the floor-standing coat stand has a slender metal upright, short rounded hooks and a stable circular foot.
On the upper-right wall, the slim architectural sconce has a narrow metal housing and recessed diffuser attached to a flush backplate.
